6632.title: Compact panel toggle chrome
6632.rootCauseOneLine: Home and drawer toggles use different glyph sizing, foreground tokens and trailing insets.
6632.proposedFix: Reuse header hide-control sizing, apply the shared subtle foreground to the home toggle, and use 16px trailing drawer-row padding.
6632.caveats: Reproduced twice in Chromium touch emulation; physical iOS Safari and nonzero hardware safe-area insets were not tested.
